note: Set A captures the definitions of ∆Ω and ∆Ω̇ (low-speed shaft speed perturbation and acceleration), which Set B omits entirely, while both sets otherwise agree on the symbol definitions and the Region 3 relationships. Set B does include the aerodynamic-torque assumption (negligible variation with rotor speed) that A misses, but it also repeats the generator-torque/generator-speed relationship twice (once as TGen, once as a generic 'generator torque' claim), which is redundant and trivial. Both sets bind values correctly with supporting quotes and no invented facts, so A's coverage of distinct, correct claims is slightly better.
